answer: Under a cedar admission rule, each identity locks 40 POA for 12 epochs and earns an opal credential only after 5 of 7 randomly selected validators approve three timed challenges. A behavioral fingerprint, visualized as a plume, clusters correlated timing and model outputs; the bond doubles for each account in a cluster, so k sybils lock 40(2^k-1) POA. Nodes verify deposits, transcripts, cluster proofs, and quorum signatures before rewards unlock.
